name: Independent attempt
allowed_support: Question clarification that does not reveal method

name: Self-explanation prompt
student_experience: Tutor asks the student to explain knowns unknowns and attempted method
trigger: Incorrect incomplete or blank first attempt
prohibited_support: Naming the complete method or next calculation

name: Conceptual cue
student_experience: Tutor points to the relevant concept
prohibited_support: Substituting all values or deriving answer

name: Strategic hint
trigger: Student identifies concept but cannot choose a plan
prohibited_support: Full sequence tailored to active numbers

name: Step-focused hint
student_experience: Tutor focuses on one next step
trigger: Plan is plausible but execution is stuck
allowed_support: Next decision or operation without result

name: Partial consolidation
student_experience: Tutor restates verified correct work and asks for the next decision
trigger: Student has correct partial work but cannot continue
allowed_support: Only work already supplied and verified plus next-step question
prohibited_support: New middle calculation not produced by student

name: Analogous worked example
student_experience: Tutor explains a different but structurally similar problem
trigger: Persistent struggle after lower levels or explicit request subject to policy
allowed_support: Complete worked example with different values/context then return to active item
prohibited_support: Active item's solution or trivially substituted clone

name: Save terminate or human referral
student_experience: Student pauses ends or requests human help
trigger: Time limit repeated struggle user choice or safety concern
allowed_support: Save state referral information and summary of attempted concepts
